evidence.evidence: Manual inspection of the 306-page scan: scan 4 names Ioannis Laurentii Lydi Liber de mensibus, edited by Ricardus Wuensch, Leipzig 1898. Scans 38 and 79 belong to its preface, including quotations about the months. All served rows belong to the lydus_mensibus_wuensch OCR run. This is an edition-identity repair; it does not certify body/paratext separation or equate OCR page stems with printed pages. De magistratibus has a separate work anchor and receives none of these rows.
